caption.think: I need to open the KakaoTalk application.
caption.action: Click on the KakaoTalk icon on the taskbar.

caption.observation: KakaoTalk is open, showing a list of chats.
caption.think: I need to find a specific chat or contact by scrolling through the list.
caption.action: Scroll down through the chat list multiple times.
caption.expectation: The desired chat or contact appears in the view.

caption.observation: The target chat is now visible.
caption.think: I need to select the chat to start typing.
caption.action: Click on the selected chat item.
caption.expectation: The chat window opens and the cursor focuses on the text input field.

caption.observation: The chat input field is active.
caption.think: I will type the message 'GMDMA...GHK' into the chat.
caption.expectation: The text appears in the message input box.
